title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Assalamualikum, Is it permissable to use intrest money to build Toilet in the Madrasah? 2051 views Q. As Salamu alaykum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatahu, Moulana, this is regarding health insurance. The company that i work for is giving medical benefit for employees, wife and 2 children with no amount being payed. At the same time, it gives benefits for parents at some amount being paid. Can this be taken? If answer is No, and if we have done it already what should be done? Jazakallah Khair, ALLAH HAFIZ, As Salamu alaykum 2074 views Q. Home Loan 5539 views Q. I wanted to know that is doing a job in banking and financial sector is prohibited in islam? While there are lots of opportunities for muslim youths. 1847 views Q. When it is haram to accept interst and to invest the money in Insurance, how is that the musalman can save his money(money retained by him after actual expenses in the month or year) ? What is the concept of savings(bachat) in the Islam? 2522 views Q. Regarding PPF account 2801 views Q. Is bank loan permisible in India for business purpose? if yes what are the criteria and if no why? 2081 views Q. I live in a Muslim society in mumbai.the society charges a fixed maintainance amount to the members monthly.they charge a penalty if it is not paid on time in terms of percentage.if the bill is not paid for second month they again charge a penalty in percentage first on the bill of that month then they combine the previous unpaid bill with this bill and again charge intrest on the total amount.and this goes on for months.if a person has to pay rs 10,000he is made to pay 15,000 for example.is it permissible to charge intrest in such a manner or haram as it puts undue burden on our muslim brothers who are unable to pay the bill on time due to financial problems.i have proposed the society to charge a fix penalty for eg rs 100 on every unpaid bill so that our brothers are not burdened with heavy interest. 2544 views Q. Can I use the interest amount (₹7,190) from my deposited college fees to pay for my additional semester fees (₹23,000)? 1919 views Q. Question regarding Insurance. 2091 views Q. To Get the Loan from Company without any interest but insured one( Under insurance cover) 1726 views Q. Regard to fatwa ID 6948. is it allowed to buy a house in the same manner ? Prophet SAW cursed the accepter of interest and its giver,and the two witnesses and the one who records it,and he said they are all equal. doesen't this contradict what you have said ? INTEREST isit haram by its nature or depends on how you use it ? please throw some light on this. jazakallah. 1765 views Q. Getting interest from bank as only sole income for older people permissable or not and income from mutual fund company is permissible or not? 2083 views Q. Dear Ulama Ikram,Assalamualaikkum. I'm a lecturer in a government aided college.Recently the state government has released UGC [University Grants commision ] arrears due to me since 1996.Of this a substantial portion is stated to be interest for the accumulated amount. Some six months back my father met with a near fatal accident,but with allah's grace is recovering now. The medical expenditure was huge and well beyond my current means and was met from borrowings from friends and loans from banks. Can I utilise this interest amount from the UGC arrears to defray the medical expenditure incurred for reasons that (i) I'm still indebted to my friends and am yet to repay them? (ii)The income tax that I have paid and will be paying this financial year is greater than the UGC arrear intrest paid to me by the government? I'm in a confused state. Enlighten me and pray that allah gives me the thoufeeq to follow his laws in letter and sprit at any cost. Jazzakallahu Khair. 1816 views Q. Can interest money be used as accident compensation? 1840 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 170812 Country: India Title: Using Interest for availing banking services Question: Can we use interest to pay bank services and maintenance fees for e.g Minimum Account Balance penalty, ATM charges and Credit card Service fees. Answer ID: 170812 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 856/701/SD=09/1440) It is not lawful to use interest money to pay ATM charge, credit service fee etc. one should spend interest money on poor and needy ones without an intention of reward. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
